d:
Lok aastha ke mahaparv ko lekar charon or dhum hai. 13 navanbar ko nahay-khay ke sath char divsiy chhath puja ki shuruaat ho gaee hai. 14 navanbar ko kharna, 15 navanbar ko sandhya arghy aur 16 navanbar ko subah ke arghy ke sath yah puja sanpann hogi. is mahaparv ki khas bat yah hai ki ismen ugte aur dubte donon sury ki upasna ki jati hai. aise men chhath puja ke mauke par ham bihar ke us sury mandir ke bare men janenge, jo chhath vratiyon ke lie aastha ka pramukh kendr hai.
